svg.title: Civic Evidence Weave: AI spatial tests and human decision loop
svg.desc: A conceptual flow from civic question and site conditions through reversible components, non-identifying observation and human review to retain, adjust or remove decisions.
svg.text: Civic Evidence Weave | AI spatial tests and human decision loop
Concept protocol: no identity, trajectory or biometric data; no algorithm decides admission, allocation, enforcement, evaluation or refusal of service.

g.text: T-01 Walking and wayfinding: continuous alternative route + paper sign + accessibility walkover
T-02 Public inquiry and feedback: staffed counter + paper intake + named closure owner
T-03 Reversible component and maintenance: clearance + named maintainer + before/during/after record
Spatial anchors, responsibilities, conditions and exits: visual/assets/implementation_spatial_register.json (provisional concepts, not engineering or approval evidence)
